name: Arab USD
description: Arab USD (AUSD) is InvestArab's BNB Smart Chain token with a $1 accounting value and a $1 external target. Supply is capped at 10 billion and issued only against deposited collateral, redeemable 1:1. The deployed collateral is a custom token named USDT, not canonical BSC USDT; its dollar value is not independently attested. AUSD trades against canonical BSC USDT on PancakeSwap V2. Source is verified on BscScan and Sourcify.
